Every recording claim (D-086, D-145, D-185, D-197, D-219, D-265, D-268, D-270) was read from COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md and, where a commit was cited, resolved with git. Every cited verdict was read from the review file's own bytes; every 'Codex not reviewed' assertion was tested by probing for the named file.
